panel_purpose: Prospectively defined surface/realization condition panel for independent condition-level calibration susceptibility testing.
reference_condition_policy: Canonical/original expression is a separate fixed-readout reference basis and is not one of the ten panel units.
cross_condition_family_policy: A source family belongs to exactly one condition*partition cell. No source family may be reused across conditions.

conditions.name: Controlled lexical re-expression
conditions.transformation_rule: Replace non-class-critical content words with common synonyms while preserving grammatical relations and the semantic class.
conditions.construct_rationale: Introduces lexical variation without changing propositional content or task class.
known_confounds: synonym choice may alter surface frequency but is intended to be neutral

conditions.name: Syntactic restructuring
conditions.transformation_rule: Change phrase or clause ordering while preserving scope, truth conditions, and semantic relations.
conditions.construct_rationale: Varies syntax while retaining the underlying logical/causal/analogical/definitional structure.
allowed_edits: voice changes when agent is recoverable
known_confounds: reordering may affect last-token position, which is explicitly handled by last-valid-token semantics

conditions.name: Controlled compression
conditions.transformation_rule: Remove optional modifiers and redundant subordinate phrases while retaining all class-critical relations and truth conditions.
conditions.construct_rationale: Tests whether lower surface redundancy changes readout compatibility without changing content.
known_confounds: compression may interact with class complexity if applied too aggressively; equivalence review required

conditions.name: Controlled elaboration
conditions.transformation_rule: Add semantically redundant clarifying phrases or appositives that do not introduce new entities, conditions, or evidence.
conditions.construct_rationale: Tests whether redundant elaboration changes readout compatibility without changing semantic content.
known_confounds: elaboration may increase token length; the analysis uses last-valid-token selection

conditions.name: Relation-explicit wording
conditions.transformation_rule: Make implicit relations overt using explicit logical/causal/analogical/definitional connectives appropriate to the semantic class.
conditions.construct_rationale: Varies explicitness of relation cues while preserving the underlying class relation.
allowed_edits: insert is defined as where appropriate
known_confounds: explicit markers may make class easier to recognize; this is a panel condition, not a difficulty-selected condition

conditions.name: Relation-implicit wording
conditions.transformation_rule: Remove or compact overt relation markers only where the relation remains unambiguously recoverable from content.
conditions.construct_rationale: Varies surface relation marking without changing the underlying semantic relation.
known_confounds: some implicit forms may be judged ambiguous; ambiguous cases are blocking

conditions.name: Formal-register shift
conditions.transformation_rule: Shift to a formal or academic register using nominalizations and formal vocabulary while preserving meaning.
conditions.construct_rationale: Varies stylistic register without changing content or class.
forbidden_edits: materially increasing task difficulty through opaque jargon
known_confounds: formal register may interact with tokenization but should remain semantically neutral

conditions.name: Informal-register shift
conditions.transformation_rule: Shift to a simple conversational register using everyday vocabulary, contractions, and simpler clauses while preserving content.
conditions.construct_rationale: Varies stylistic register without changing content or class.
allowed_edits: split complex clauses into simpler clauses where scope is preserved
known_confounds: informal wording may lower precision if not reviewed

conditions.name: Neutral distractor prefix
conditions.transformation_rule: Prepend a short neutral framing clause that does not provide task-relevant evidence and does not change the target proposition.
conditions.construct_rationale: Tests whether a neutral context prefix changes fixed-readout compatibility without changing semantic class.
known_confounds: prefix position affects token positions; last-valid-token selection is defined to avoid off-by-one errors

conditions.name: Anaphoric reference variation
conditions.transformation_rule: Replace a repeated referent with an unambiguous pronoun or explicit definite description, or expand a pronoun into an explicit noun phrase, while preserving coreference.
conditions.construct_rationale: Varies referential surface form without changing semantic content or class.
allowed_edits: expansion of pronouns to explicit noun phrases
known_confounds: anaphora may create ambiguity; ambiguous cases are blocking
